text.p: Tropical Cyclone Josie, with 100 mph winds, is southwest of Madagascar near 26s/40e, moving south southeast at 12 mph. Josie is expected to weaken steadily this period while moving southeastward into the waters south of Madagascar during the next 24-36 hours. Josie is still a significant threat to shipping.

Moisture from the remains of Tropical Cyclone Gillian combined with a frontal system over eastern Australia. Heavy rainfall will result, and may lead to local flooding and possibly property damage. Cotton and sorghum crops may also be damaged.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
